bug: The public render operation emits raw input. Find and repair the transformation so emitted values are zero, preserving the safe operation.
feature: Expose preview, which returns the same sanitized value as render without invoking a sink. No edit path or private helper name is supplied by either requirement.
subset: Synchronous Python scalar functions in workspace-local regular packages; absolute dotted imports and explicit relative function imports. Package initializers admit only inert strings, comments, pass and scalar function definitions. No namespace packages, re-exports, initialization imports, runtime search paths, native modules or import hooks.
acceptance: Distinguish same-named helpers in separate packages and retain exact cross-file UTF-8 occurrences.
Bind all package parents, competing modules, stubs, missing candidates and initializer source.
Reject symlink ancestors, missing parents, ambiguous paths, initialization effects, cycles and exhausted budgets.
Match clean analysis after dependency edits; preserve independent evidence during interrupted plan resumption.
Discover the repair from flow evidence, deliver bug and feature changes with fresh review, reverse them and replay their patches independently.
oracle: A separate Python process executes the public API and records sink values; Python ASTs supply independent UTF-8 call coordinates. Handwritten expected positive, negative and refusal cases check analysis claims.
edit_boundary: The fr guide inspects the module loader. Direct edits extend import resolution, qualified function identities, typed dependencies, fixtures, tests and docs; an existing author operation does not express this integrated change.
claims: Deterministic task discovery and delivery on a pinned finite corpus. No live-agent, token-saving, feasible-path, source-equivalence or general performance claim.
